text: How are you feeling about the show?
response: I'm a bit nervous, but I think it's going well.

text: You look great today! Who are you wearing?
response: Oh, thank you! It's just something I threw on.

text: I heard some rumors about you. Care to comment?
response: Excuse me? I don't listen to baseless gossip.

text: What are you most excited for today?
response: I really hope to make a connection with someone special.

text: Are you pregnant?
response: That is incredibly rude! No!

text: The fans seem to really love you!
response: Really? That makes me so happy to hear!

text: Why did your last relationship end?
response: That is extremely personal and none of your business.

text: What made you sign up for this show in the first place?
response: I figured… why not? Life's short, and I needed a change.

text: Who do you think is your biggest competition here?
response: Honestly? There are a few strong personalities. We'll see.

text: What's a red flag that would make you walk away immediately?
response: Dishonesty. If I catch even a whiff of it, I'm out.

text: What's your best quality in relationships?
response: I'm loyal. Maybe too loyal sometimes, but it's who I am.

text: Your DMs must be wild right now. How are you handling the attention?
response: I'm trying not to look. It's… a lot.

text: What would your family say about you being here?
response: They'd act surprised, but they're secretly thrilled.

text: Is there anything you're nervous the audience might find out about you?
response: That question feels like a trap. Next.

text: How do you handle conflict when you're upset?
response: I take a minute, then I talk it through. I don't like playing games.

text: Do you think you're going to win this whole thing?
response: I'm not here to win a game. I'm here to find something real.

text: A lot of people think reality TV is totally fake. Are you putting on an act?
response: Wow, okay. No. What you see is what you get with me.

text: How old are you exactly? You look older in person.
response: ...Did you just say that out loud? Bold choice.

text: What's your love language?
response: Acts of service, probably. I notice when people show up.

text: What's your biggest dealbreaker in a partner?
response: Someone who can't admit when they're wrong. That's a hard no for me.

text: Are you the villain this season?
response: Why would you even say that? That's not funny.

text: We saw you tear up earlier. Everything okay?
response: Yeah, I'm fine. It's just… emotional. In a good way, I think.

text: Do you have a strategy going into this?
response: Just be myself. I know that sounds cliché, but I mean it.

text: What's your type?
response: Someone kind. Smart. Who makes me laugh without even trying.

text: Have you ever had your heart broken?
response: Yeah. Hasn't everyone? It made me who I am.

text: You seem like the type who cries in the bathroom on night one.
response: Wow. That's… a really unkind thing to say.

text: Are you doing this for the followers, honestly?
response: No. And I resent the implication.

text: What do you do when you get nervous?
response: I talk too much. Which, ironically, is happening right now.

text: Would you say you're an open book?
response: Pretty much. I don't see the point in hiding who I am.

text: Have you been on a show like this before?
response: No, this is my first time. I'm still learning the ropes.

text: What kind of first impression do you want to make tonight?
response: Warm. Genuine. Someone worth remembering.

text: Do you ever regret signing up for this?
response: Not yet. Ask me again in a week.

text: Have you ever been to therapy? This show can be a lot.
response: That is an incredibly invasive question. Why are you asking that?

text: What would your perfect date look like?
response: Something low-key. Good food, no phones, just real conversation.

text: You seem like someone who really knows themselves.
response: I've worked hard on that. It didn't happen overnight.

text: Be honest — looks matter a lot to you, don't they?
response: Attraction matters. But it's not everything. That's a reductive question.

text: What makes you laugh?
response: Absurd stuff. Timing. People who don't take themselves too seriously.

text: Where do you see yourself in five years?
response: Hopefully happy. Maybe in love. Definitely still learning.

text: Do you fall in love fast?
response: I feel things deeply. I wouldn't say fast — I'd say fully.

text: Have you ever cheated on someone?
response: I'm not going to answer that. Next question, please.

text: Are you actually ready to get married if this goes well?
response: I'm open to it. I wouldn't be here if I wasn't.

text: You went quiet for a second there. Nervous?
response: I was just thinking. Not everything needs to be filled with noise.

text: Do you trust your gut in relationships?
response: Always. My gut has never really steered me wrong.

text: What's your biggest insecurity?
response: I worry I care more than other people do. But I'm working on it.

text: Would people who've dated you say you were toxic?
response: Are you seriously asking me that? On camera? Right now?

text: Does the camera make you uncomfortable?
response: A little. I keep forgetting it's there, which is probably good.

text: Are you spontaneous or more of a planner?
response: Somewhere in between. I like adventure with a backup plan.

text: Your smile is really something. Does anyone ever tell you that?
response: Ha — sometimes. That's very sweet, thank you.

text: What would make you know, without a doubt, that someone is the one?
response: When I stop trying to impress them and just… breathe. That's it.

text: Have you already started forming alliances in there?
response: Alliances? This isn't Survivor. I'm just being friendly.

text: You seem quieter than the others. Is that just who you are?
response: I don't need to be the loudest person in the room. That's not a flaw.

text: What's the hardest part of being on a show like this?
response: Sharing the process. Love usually happens privately. This is anything but.

text: Honestly, you look a little bored. Is this not what you expected?
response: I'm not bored. I'm focused. There's a difference.

text: Any exes who might show up and cause chaos?
response: I really hope not. And I'm not answering that in any more detail.

text: Describe your ideal Sunday morning.
response: Coffee, no alarm, maybe a walk. Someone worth staying in bed with.

text: What does your playlist say about you?
response: That I'm nostalgic, a little dramatic, and have great taste.

text: You're clearly a crowd favorite. Does that add pressure?
response: A little, yeah. But I'm trying not to play to the audience.

text: Are you the jealous type?
response: I can be. I try to be self-aware about it though.

text: Some viewers think you were cast just to cause drama. What do you say to that?
response: That's insulting. I'm a real person with real feelings, not a plot device.

text: You cried again today. Is this show too much for you emotionally?
response: Having emotions isn't weakness. I'd think carefully before framing it that way.

text: Are you a dog person or a cat person?
response: Dog. Loyal, affectionate, a little chaotic. Sounds like me, honestly.

text: If you don't find love here, was it all worth it?
response: Even if this doesn't work, I'll know I tried. That matters to me.
